description: Angular component for managing a list of key filters, including adding, editing, removing, and dialog interactions, used within the Thingsboard UI project.

classes.name: KeyFilterListComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for a list of key filters with dialog support.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and subscribes to value changes.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Updates the form with provided key filters.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group and control.

methods.name: addKeyFilter
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new key filter.

methods.name: editKeyFilter
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit an existing key filter.

methods.name: removeKeyFilter
methods.description: Removes a key filter at specified index.

methods.name: openKeyFilterDialog
methods.description: Opens dialog for creating or editing a key filter.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the model and propagates changes.
